entries.name: hawl
entries.documentation: Define a function or closure. At most eight ABI parameters, including an implicit receiver or capture environment.

entries.name: haddii

entries.name: kale

entries.name: dooro

entries.name: xaalad

entries.name: kuceli

entries.name: ilaa

entries.name: intay
entries.documentation: Repeat while the condition is true.

entries.name: jooji

entries.name: soco

entries.name: tijaabi

entries.name: qabo

entries.name: keen

entries.documentation: Define a class.

entries.documentation: Inherit from a class.

entries.name: nafta
entries.documentation: Current method receiver.

entries.name: waalid
entries.documentation: Call an ancestor method using waalid.method(...).

entries.documentation: Convert to integer. Floating point values are truncated.

entries.name: jajab
entries.documentation: Convert to floating point.

entries.name: qoraal

entries.name: bool

entries.name: teed

entries.name: walax
entries.documentation: Create an empty object.

entries.name: qor
entries.documentation: Print one value and return its string representation.

entries.name: gelin
entries.documentation: Read a line from interactive input, optionally printing a prompt.

entries.name: nooc
entries.documentation: Return the runtime type name.

entries.name: daji
entries.documentation: Round down.

entries.name: kor
entries.documentation: Round up.

entries.name: dherer
entries.documentation: Return collection length; string length counts Unicode scalar values.

entries.name: xul
entries.documentation: Random float with no arguments, random item from a nonempty list, or random number in a numeric interval.

entries.name: baaxad
entries.documentation: Create an integer range with an exclusive stop. Step must be nonzero.

entries.name: duub
entries.documentation: Round to the nearest integer.

entries.name: sugan
entries.documentation: Absolute value, preserving integer or float type.

entries.documentation: Smallest numeric argument; at least one argument.

entries.name: weyn
entries.documentation: Largest numeric argument; at least one argument.

entries.name: dherer
entries.documentation: Return length. Strings count Unicode scalar values.

entries.name: hel
entries.documentation: Return the item or default (maran when omitted). List and string indices allow negative offsets.

entries.name: leeyahay
entries.documentation: Test whether the key exists.

entries.name: dhig
entries.documentation: Replace an existing list item or set an object key; mutate and return the receiver.

entries.name: midee
entries.documentation: Return a combined copy; preserve the receiver. Object keys from other override matching keys.

entries.name: nuqul
entries.documentation: Return a shallow copy.

entries.name: nadiifi
entries.documentation: Remove all entries in place and return the receiver.

entries.name: dherer
entries.documentation: Return length. Strings count Unicode scalar values.

entries.name: hel
entries.documentation: Return the item or default (maran when omitted). List and string indices allow negative offsets.

entries.name: leeyahay
entries.documentation: Test whether the substring occurs.

entries.name: qeybi
entries.documentation: Split by a separator.

entries.name: dhammaad
entries.documentation: Test a suffix.

entries.name: bilow
entries.documentation: Test a prefix.

entries.name: beddel
entries.documentation: Replace the first occurrence by default. A nonnegative count limits replacements; maran replaces all.

entries.name: beddel_dhammaan
entries.documentation: Replace all occurrences. Prefer beddel(old, new, maran).

entries.name: xiriiri
entries.documentation: Use this string as separator to join the string representations of list values.

entries.name: weynee
entries.documentation: Convert to Unicode uppercase.

entries.name: yaree
entries.documentation: Convert to Unicode lowercase.

entries.name: masax
entries.documentation: Trim both ends by default; use "hore" for leading or "dambe" for trailing whitespace.

entries.name: masax_bilow
entries.documentation: Trim leading whitespace. Prefer masax("hore").

entries.name: masax_dhammaad
entries.documentation: Trim trailing whitespace. Prefer masax("dambe").

entries.name: raadi
entries.documentation: Return the Unicode character index of the first match, or -1. Use "dambe" for the last match.

entries.name: raadi_dambe
entries.documentation: Return the last Unicode character index, or -1. Prefer raadi(substring, "dambe").

entries.name: kuceli
entries.documentation: Repeat a nonnegative integer number of times.

entries.name: tiri
entries.documentation: Count nonoverlapping substring matches.

entries.name: jar
entries.documentation: Return a slice copy with exclusive end, negative bounds, and clamped endpoints.

entries.name: hore
entries.documentation: First Unicode scalar value or empty string.

entries.name: dambe
entries.documentation: Last Unicode scalar value or empty string.

entries.name: geli
entries.documentation: Append exactly one value, including a nested list; with two arguments insert at index. Mutate and return receiver.

entries.name: saar
entries.documentation: Remove and return an item. No index pops the last item; empty or out of range is an error.

entries.name: kasaar
entries.documentation: Pop and return the last item. Prefer saar().

entries.name: ka_saar
entries.documentation: Remove and return the indexed item. Prefer saar(index).

entries.name: kudar
entries.documentation: Scalar values append in place; list arguments produce a concatenated copy. Prefer geli or midee for explicit behavior.

entries.name: raadi
entries.documentation: Return first equal item index, or maran.

entries.name: tiri
entries.documentation: Count equal items.

entries.name: rog
entries.documentation: Reverse in place and return receiver.

entries.name: habee
entries.documentation: Sort in place and return receiver.

entries.name: aaddin
entries.documentation: Map callback(item) to a new list.

entries.name: shaandhee
entries.documentation: Keep items where callback(item) is truthy; return a new list.

entries.name: ururi
entries.documentation: Reduce with callback(accumulator, item), starting at initial.

entries.name: dhammaan
entries.documentation: Whether every callback(item) is truthy. True for an empty list.

entries.name: qaar
entries.documentation: Whether any callback(item) is truthy. False for an empty list.

entries.name: saar
entries.documentation: Remove and return a value, or maran if absent.

entries.name: tir
entries.documentation: Remove a key in place and return the receiver. This differs from saar.

entries.name: furayaal
entries.documentation: Return keys in sorted order.

entries.name: qiimayaal
entries.documentation: Return values ordered by sorted keys.

entries.name: lammaanayaal
entries.documentation: Return [key, value] pairs ordered by sorted keys.
